title: Sugar Johnny's trumpet style
summary: Duhé calls Sugar Johnny a smooth trumpet player in the manner of Bunk.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Mr. Bray, what kind of a style is Sugar John? You told me before that he was your first trumpet player. Nice trumpet player. What kind of a style did he play? I don't know. I couldn't tell you.
But he's a smooth trumpet player. He's a pretty honest style of bunk. Bunkway on smooth. On the order of bunk too. Yeah, smooth, smooth trumpet player. Good morning.
